comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
The blue version (+1 astronomy) and red version (+1 appraisal) can be made if a special npc appears in the square of the company colony: sewing master (male = blue, female = red).

I am not sure what the requirements are to make them appears. The other 2 recipes from the male sewing master are part of a memorial album.
You should be able to see the special npc's that appear in the colony of other companies, so have a look there as well.
